senses.def: Of or relating to Cyzicus, an ancient town in Anatolia.
A native or inhabitant of Cyzicus.
Of, from or relating to Cyzicus
A native or inhabitant of Cyzicus

Of or pertaining to, or being, a large north-facing hall with a prospect towards the gardens; the windows of this hall opened down to the ground, so that the green verdure could be seen by those lying on the couches.
A former city in Balikesir Province, Turkey, formerly part of the ancient region of Mysia.
